title: Green Citrus / Simplified Study
subtitle: A bright citrus-green accord study for testing the complete Formula Drop publishing workflow.
description:
FORMULA COMPOSITION
Bergamot FCF
Lemon Oil
Petitgrain Oil
Linalool
Linalyl acetate
Dihydromyrcenol
Hedione
cis-3-Hexenol
Verdox
Galaxolide
-----
A lightweight citrus-green study built around fresh peel, leafy brightness, and a clean diffusive drydown.

This Formula Drop is being used to verify the complete Accordbook publishing workflow, including the permanent archive, social preview, download, and import experience.
